title: Count Numbers With Unique Digits II
summary: Determine the quantity of numbers with distinct digits within the interval from a to b, including both endpoints.
statement: Determine the quantity of numbers with distinct digits within the interval from a to b, including both endpoints.
constraints: Count integers in the inclusive range a through b.
A value qualifies only when every decimal digit occurs once.
Return the number of qualifying values.
hints: Inspect each value independently within the small range.
Convert a number to decimal text and compare its set size with its digit count.
Equal sizes mean no digit was repeated.
The inclusive loop visits every candidate once and the size equality is equivalent to digit uniqueness.
editorial: The inclusive loop visits every candidate once and the size equality is equivalent to digit uniqueness.

tests.explanation: Every value qualifies except eleven, giving nineteen.
Nine, ten, twelve through nineteen qualify; eleven is excluded, giving ten.
